scope: All tracked public code/config surfaces under the declared roots, plus new source files; not every runtime entity or private/provider record.

boundaries.label: Private installations/profiles
boundaries.limit: Installation-scoped reporting; never merge names into global people; excluded from public marketing.

boundaries.label: Private authored stories/questions
boundaries.limit: Private records are not enumerated or copied.

boundaries.label: Pairings and family media
boundaries.limit: Separate grants and recovery; no save-sharing inference.

boundaries.label: Ledger/provider documents
boundaries.limit: Schema is source; actual invoices, balances and payments are not source definitions.

boundaries.label: Database/provider state
boundaries.limit: Bindings and credentials remain private; source does not prove service readiness.

boundaries.label: Marketing observations
boundaries.limit: Consent-based aggregates; Play clicks do not prove game starts or identify children.

limitations: Domain attribution is a reviewable filename-based grouping; shared imports cross domains.
Dynamic imports, DOM messages, runtime identifiers and API dispatch need consumer review beyond lexical import evidence.
Asset binaries and recording catalogues are covered by separate manifests; never interpreted as child/profile records.
No all-domain control/playability percentage is inferred.
